Safety Information

Dear Healthcare Professional Letters

This section provides copies of letters sent to healthcare professionals by the therapeutic products industry. These letters detail possible safety or quality concerns, they are published here on behalf of the industry. These letters are provided voluntarily and this section may not be comprehensive.
